newsitem.title: USA: VSI in $700,000 contract from Interclinical.
newsitem.headline: VSI in $700,000 contract from Interclinical.

text.p: VSI Enterprises Inc said Friday that its United Kingdom subsidiary, Videoconferencing Systems Ltd, has received a purchase order for its Telemedix line of telemedicine products from privately-hedl Interclinical Ltd for about $700,000.
The order calls for 12 Telemedix 2000 Rollabout Telemedicine Workstations to be delivered over the next six months with an extended service and software upgrade package.

VSI, in conjunction with privately-held Global Telemedix Inc of Boston, Mass., offers an innovative line of telemedicine products that can be utilized in multimedia environments, and comprehensive, single-point contact support for complex telemedicine networks.
